title: Piston Push Limit Changer
description: Changes piston push limit from 12 to 64. Works without api files. Works on version 26.1+ (inclusive)
body: Forge mod. Changes the vanilla piston push limit from 12 to 64 blocks. It works completely without the forge api. Works on version 26.1+ (inclusive). I can also make a custom push limit if you need one. Just contact me.
